primary_source.title: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring

source_exact_axioms.ii: S is connected and no vertex in V(G) minus S is complete to S.
source_exact_axioms.iii: Y0 = V(G) minus (N(S) union X0 union S).
source_exact_axioms.iv: No vertex in V(G) minus (Y0 union X0) is mixed on an edge of Y0.

corrected_B2B0_obligations.i_G_minus_X0_connected: PASS candidate is trivial under the one-step construction because G and X0 are unchanged.
corrected_B2B0_obligations.ii_seed_connected: For each forced u in X union Y, source axiom (iii) implies u is not in Y0 and hence u has an old seed neighbor; adding u to S preserves connectedness. For a forced nonadjacent pair u,v, each has an old seed neighbor, so S union {u,v} is connected.
corrected_B2B0_obligations.ii_no_outside_complete_to_seed: If a vertex outside the enlarged seed were complete to the enlarged seed, it would be complete to the old seed, contradicting source axiom (ii).
corrected_B2B0_obligations.iii_Y0_canonicality: For one force, Y0'=Y0 minus N(u). For a pair, Y0''=Y0 minus (N(u) union N(v)). Old non-Y0 vertices cannot enter the residual because source axiom (iii) already gives them an old-seed neighbor.
corrected_B2B0_obligations.iv_no_mixing: Use old axiom (iv), dynamic-to-component uniformity, and the fact that distinct old Y0 components are anticomplete. Removed old Y0 vertices lie only in whole removed components; newly forced vertices are anticomplete to retained components.

canonical_pair_force_partition.properness_guard: uv is a nonedge and c lies in A(u) intersect A(v), so the newly fixed assignments are proper relative to each other and to all already fixed vertices.
